ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Act on Reporting and Using Certain Financial Transaction Information (Act No. 17214, as amended), its Enforcement Decree, and the Financial Services Commission supervisory regulations; the Act on Regulation and Punishment of Criminal Proceeds Concealment; the Commercial Act Articles 19, 24, 543 and 547 on trade name, registered office, director records and corporate registration; and the Supreme Court Registration Rules requiring corporate registration extracts. These instruments collectively impose mandatory customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, suspicious transaction reporting, and regulatory access for the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit, without creating a general public beneficial ownership register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Company Registration Extract and Business Registration Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent District Court Registry of the Supreme Court of Korea and the National Tax Service (Hometax portal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarization of the certified registry extract by a Korean notary public, followed by issuance of an Apostille certificate by the Apostille Section of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarization by a Korean notary public, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and final legalization by the consular post of the destination state located in the Republic of Korea. The two routes are never sequenced concurrently.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certified Company Registration Particulars and Business Registration Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Supreme Court Registration Office through the competent District Court registry and the National Tax Service
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: obtain a certified extract from the court registry and the tax service, have it notarized by a Korean notary public, and request an Apostille certificate from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: have the certified extract notarized by a Korean notary public, authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and then legalized by the destination state's consular post in the Republic of Korea. No document may pass through both Apostille and consular legalization stages.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing pre-incorporation filings, bank account opening, and foreign legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the incorporating corporate shareholder, notarized by a Korean notary public and certified by the Korean attorney of record
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarization by a Korean notary public, then Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarization by a Korean notary public, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and legalization by the destination state's consular post in the Republic of Korea. These routes are mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Certified Notarial Copy of the Korean Articles of Incorporation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Korean notary public acting with the incorporators and the supervising licensed attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: certified notarial copy followed by Apostille certification from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: certified notarial copy, followed by authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and legalization by the destination state's consular post in the Republic of Korea. The applicable route is determined solely by the destination state's membership in the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the prospective Yuhan Hoesa bank account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the Republic of Korea where the corporate shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner maintains an operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarization of the bank officer's signature by a Korean notary public, then Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarization of the bank officer's signature, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and legalization by the destination state's consular post in the Republic of Korea. The two authentication methods are mutually exclusive alternatives, never combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner and Shareholder Register Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The corporate shareholder's corporate secretary or registered agent, notarized and confirmed by legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive path: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarize the register extract in Korea, then obtain an Apostille from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarize the extract, authenticate it with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, and legalize it at the destination state's consular post in the Republic of Korea. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and cannot be applied to the same instrument in sequence.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before acceptance, the Korean legal counsel must screen all proposed directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and material counterparties against the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) sanctions and watch-list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU and UK designated persons lists, FATF high-risk jurisdiction listings, Interpol notices, and proprietary PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, high-remittance jurisdictions, or transactions sourced through digital assets; any positive hit, adverse media, unexplained wealth, or nominee chain requires escalation to KoFIU-compliant deeper investigation and senior management approval before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Supreme Court of Korea Internet Registration Office (iROS) trade-name search and reservation portal, supplemented by the Korean Intellectual Property Office trademark search portal for auxiliary conflict screening.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory trade name in the Korean registry must be in the Korean alphabet. For a foreign-owned Yuhan Hoesa, the articles must state the Korean trade name, a back-transliteration into Latin characters, and the original foreign-language name if any. The four-tier naming convention requires concordance between: (1) the corporate type identifier Yuhan Hoesa (limited liability company); (2) the Korean trade name proper; (3) the official Romanized transliteration prepared under the Revised Romanization of Korean; and (4) the registered English foreign name. Unless all four tiers are reconciled in one filing, the registry may reject the name at the clearance stage.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An iROS name reservation is renewable once before the initial 30-day window expires. If the registry rejects the trade name, the applicant must first request a written statement of reasons. The applicant may then file a formal objection with the competent District Court registry within 14 days and, if unsuccessful, file an administrative suit with the administrative court under the Administrative Litigation Act. The appeal package must include the original rejection notice, the reserved name printout, proposed articles of association, evidence of no confusingly similar registered trade name, and two substitute names in four-tier form. The registry court is required to act without delay; any official inaction should be followed by a new application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a Yuhan Hoesa engaged in plush doll manufacturing, OEM production, computerized embroidery, and ultrasonic seaming, a virtual office or commercial mailbox will not satisfy the National Tax Service's business-place registration requirements if the entity is expected to maintain inventory, production equipment, or employment in Korea. Banks conducting customer due diligence will usually demand a physical inspection or a lease contract for the office, and municipal tax authorities may issue an ex officio corrected registration if the address is a mere mail drop. If the business is purely a holding unit with all operational activity offshore, a commercial business center may be permitted, but the Korean banking AML regime will apply enhanced scrutiny. Virtual office use is therefore permissible only in narrowly documented non-operational cases.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Qualified inspection checklist: (a) direct verification that the registered office appears in the lease register; (b) visible company signage or nameplate at the street address; (c) availability of corporate records and accounting books at the office; (d) attendance by the director or authorized representative during business hours; (e) proper posting of the business registration certificate; and (f) matching of the VAT invoice address with the registered office. Quantified risk: 10-15% for a leased operational workshop or office; 35-40% for a commercial serviced office; 65-80% for a virtual office, shared address, or residential place where the company issues VAT invoices for manufacturing activity.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 17881, as amended), Articles 1 and 543 through 590 inclusive; particularly Articles 546 (Articles of Incorporation), 548 (Subscription of Capital Shares), 553 (Payment of Capital Contributions), 555 (Registration of Contributions), 559 (Directors), 560 (Representative Director), 587 (Registration of Incorporation); together with the Supreme Court Rules on Commercial Registration and the Foreign Investment Promotion Act for non-resident investors.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Division, Seoul Central District Court Registration Office, Supreme Court of Korea; electronic filings are processed through the Supreme Court Online Registration Center (Internet Registration System).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Yuhan Hoesa (Limited Liability Company) accompanied by the certified Articles of Incorporation and the bank-issued capital contribution deposit certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is imposed on a Yuhan Hoesa under Korean law; however, each member's contribution must be fully paid in cash or in-kind before registration. The stated capital must be deposited in a provisional bank account opened in the name of the company prior to incorporation, and the deposit balance certificate must be attached to the registration application. No blocked escrow account beyond this pre-registration deposit is required; the deposit is released to the company's corporate account upon completion of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF YUHAN HOESA LLC. WHEREAS Yuhan Hoesa LLC (the Company) has been formed under the Korean Commercial Act for the purpose of manufacturing, embroidering, ultrasonic seaming, distributing and exporting custom plush mascot stuffed animals under ISIC 3240; and WHEREAS the members have lawfully subscribed to the entire issued capital of the Company and have fully paid their respective contributions into the designated provisional bank account; and WHEREAS the Company is required to adopt a registered office, authorize banking arrangements, subscribe and verify share capital, and appoint statutory officers to lawfully conduct business in the Republic of Korea. NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, and it is hereby resolved, as follows: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The board acknowledges that the entire capital of KRW [amount] has been fully subscribed and paid by the members in accordance with Article 548 and Article 553 of the Korean Commercial Act. The representative director is directed to execute, seal and file any capital verification certificates, share subscription schedules, and member contribution records with the competent registration office and tax authority. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The board nominates [Bank Name, Branch] as the principal depositary bank of the Company. The directors and the representative director are jointly and severally authorized to open, maintain, and operate all corporate bank accounts, including current accounts, foreign currency accounts, settlement accounts, and e-commerce platform payment sub-accounts. The bank is authorized to honor any corporate payment instruction, Swift TT wire transfer, check, and electronic banking mandate bearing either the corporate seal with the signature of the representative director or any two directors' signatures as provided in the initial banking mandate form. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The registered office of the Company shall be located at [address], Republic of Korea. The representative director is instructed to file the address with the Court Registration Office, to receive all official postal service and tax notices, and to sign the lease for the registered office and factory premises. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. [Name] is appointed as representative director, [Name] as director, and [Name], if required by law, as statutory auditor. Each officer shall hold office until the next ordinary members' meeting and is vested with full authority to execute filings, obtain factory establishment certificates, environmental approvals, Civil Defense fire permits, and to represent the Company before government agencies. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Company shall indemnify each officer for any act or omission performed in good faith in furtherance of corporate business. This resolution is effective immediately upon incorporation and may be relied upon by any bank, court, ministry, or third party until duly revoked in writing by the Company's members. RESOLVED ADOPTED this ___ day of ________, 20___.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supreme Court Online Registration Center (Internet Registration System) and Invest Korea / KOTRA for non-resident investment notification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Supreme Court Online Registration Center and run a corporate name availability search to confirm that the proposed Korean trade name of Yuhan Hoesa is not identical or confusingly similar to any previously registered Korean entity. Reserve the official Korean trade name and engage a licensed Korean notary public to prepare the draft Articles of Incorporation in the Korean language. If the foreign investor remits funds that reach the statutory threshold under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, file a foreign investment notification with Invest Korea or a designated foreign exchange bank before the funds are deposited. The incorporator or local agent should obtain a power of attorney and certified passport copies. The name reservation expires if not used within six months, and it does not confer legal personality.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Proposed Articles of Incorporation in Korean
Valid passport or Korean resident registration certificate of each incorporator
Power of attorney for the local incorporation agent
Foreign investment notification form, if threshold exceeded
Proof of delivered registered office or planned factory site address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or the reservation is suspended, file a fresh name reservation application using a distinct Korean trade name after examining the Registrar's written grounds and correct all identity or notarization discrepancies. Any missing power-of-attorney documentation or foreign investor due diligence should be submitted within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Deposit of Paid-In Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A Korean Notary Public (notarial office) and a licensed commercial bank operating in the Republic of Korea.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the final Korean-language Articles of Incorporation to a notary public for formal notarization, confirming each member's contribution in cash or in-kind. Open a provisional bank account in the name of Yuhan Hoesa LLC under incorporation, expressly marked as a pre-incorporation deposit account, and pay in the full stated capital. The bank must issue a capital contribution deposit balance certificate that names the depositor, the transaction purpose, and the exact amount on deposit. The notary certifies the Articles of Incorporation, and the representative director or incorporator signs the Articles using the company seal. If any contribution is made in-kind, obtain a court-appointed examiner's appraisal report unless exempt under the Commercial Act.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Bank-issued capital contribution deposit balance certificate
Individual member capital subscription statements
Appraisal report for in-kind contributions, if applicable
Corporate seal impression certificate
Identification cards of incorporators and appointed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises an anti-money-laundering query on the source of funds, submit source-of-wealth documentation and a certifying statement from the remitting bank. If the notary refuses certification because of defective Articles, revise and re-execute the Articles and obtain a fresh notarial certification within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Court Filing for Corporate Incorporation Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Division of the District Court having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office address, with electronic submission through the Supreme Court Online Registration Center.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation registration application for Yuhan Hoesa with the competent district court registry. Attach the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the bank deposit balance certificate, signed acceptance letters from each appointed director and statutory auditor, identification evidence for each officer, proof of registered office consent from the landlord or legal holder, and evidence of payment of registration tax, local education tax, and the court filing fee. The registration officer will verify that all statutory elements of a Yuhan Hoesa are satisfied and that capital contributions are fully paid. Upon approval, the registry issues the Certificate of Registration and assigns a corporate registry number; legal personality arises at that moment.
required_dossiers: Incorporation registration application form
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Capital contribution deposit balance certificate
Written acceptance letters from directors and statutory auditor, if any
Copies of identification documents for all officers
Proof of registered office consent (landlord consent or ownership deed)
Receipts for registration tax and local education tax
Corporate seal impression certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a supplementary correction notice or suspension order, cure each identified omission within two weeks by filing amended documents and re-processing the application. If the application is rejected, file a written objection using the Non-Litigation Case Procedure Act or re-file after resolving the legal defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Business Registration and Factory Establishment Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local District Tax Office of the National Tax Service, the municipal government Factory Establishment Department, and the local Fire Safety Authority under the National Fire Agency.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Certificate of Registration, apply to the local National Tax Service for a Business Registration Certificate under the Value-Added Tax Act. Since the Company will operate a physical plush toy factory, file a factory establishment report or obtain a factory establishment certificate from the competent municipal government under the Industrial Cluster Development and Factory Establishment Act. Submit facility floor plans, a waste and wastewater discharge plan, a fire safety construction completion application, and an occupational safety and health assessment to the relevant departments. The Civil Defense clearance requires a fire safety completion certificate before production begins, and the Ministry of Employment and Labor requires a workplace hazard prevention plan for the embroidery, cutting, sewing, and packing operations.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation registration
Lease or ownership deed for the registered office and factory
Factory floor plan and site map
Factory establishment report or certificate application
Business registration application form
Fire safety completion certificate application and building drawings
Environmental registration or pollution prevention facility approval documents
Workplace hazard assessment and occupational health report
Director and employee identification registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the business registration is rejected because the stated business scope exceeds the Articles of Incorporation, amend the Articles by a member resolution and re-file with the registry. If the municipal factory establishment report is suspended, supplement the building's structural periodic inspection certificate and submit a written compliance undertaking to the fire safety authority. If environmental approval is contested, commission a third-party discharge measurement and submit a mitigation plan to the relevant Ministry of Environment office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Factory Establishment Approval Office of the Municipal Government, Korea Industrial Complex Corporation (KICOX) for industrial cluster coordination, and the Ministry of Employment and Labor for occupational safety supervision.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Factory Establishment Certificate (Gongjang Seollip Shin-go-jeung), Business License (Saeopja Deungrok-jeung), and Fire Safety Completion Certificate (Sobang Si-seol Wan-bi Jeung-myeong-weon), all of which are mandatory for physical manufacturing of plush mascots and stuffed animals.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea and the local Environmental Management Office, with technical review support from the Korea Environment Corporation (K-ECO).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration and Preliminary Environmental Review, not a Full EIA Report, because plush toy manufacturing using computerized embroidery and ultrasonic seaming is a small-scale and non-highly-polluting facility under the Korean Environmental Impact Assessment Act. The company must register as a business operator discharging specific wastewaters and, if any adhesive or coating processes are added, verify exemption from the Clean Air Conservation Act Permissive Emission Limits. If factory floor area or water use exceeds statutory thresholds, a Preliminary Environmental Review is mandatory before construction or operation approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent must not exceed COD 40 mg/L, BOD 40 mg/L, TSS 40 mg/L, total nitrogen 60 mg/L, total phosphorus 8 mg/L, and pH 5.8-8.6 under the Water Environment Conservation Act. Volatile organic compound emissions from any solvent-based adhesives or printing inks must comply with the Clean Air Conservation Act's stack emission standards, including total heating value criteria; in practice, the process should keep VOC concentration below 20 mg/Sm³ for general organic compound emissions. Any hazardous waste, including waste inks, spent adhesives, and contaminated rags, must be manifested and transported under the Waste Management Act and delivered to a licensed treatment facility; no on-site landfill or open burning is permitted. If the factory generates more than 1,000 kilograms per month of general wastes or any designated wastes, it must implement a waste management plan and report to the local environmental office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The factory must obtain a Fire Safety Completion Certificate from the National Fire Agency, confirming automatic fire alarm systems, fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and evacuation signage comply with the Fire Safety Facilities Installation and Management Act. The local Civil Defense authority requires a structural load inspection certificate for the building before operation commences. The Ministry of Employment and Labor requires submission of the Safety and Health Management Plan, appointment of a workplace safety and health manager for manufacturing sites, implementation of machine guarding for embroidery and ultrasonic seaming equipment, and completion of regular worker safety training. A workplace occupational health assessment must confirm noise, airborne fiber, lighting, and ergonomic conditions do not exceed occupational exposure limits, and industrial accident insurance registration must be completed before the first employee begins work.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea - Online Portal: HomeTax System (https://www.hometax.go.kr)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign non-resident entities must apply for a Business Registration Number (사업자등록번호) with the National Tax Service (NTS) via the HomeTax System. The application requires submission of the entity's certificate of incorporation, proof of foreign registration, and details of the local business establishment (if any). For VAT purposes, the entity must also register for VAT under the same Business Registration Number. The process can be completed online through the HomeTax portal or in person at the local tax office. A foreign entity without a domestic place of business may appoint a tax representative to obtain registration and fulfill compliance obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (Korea does not have a check-the-box election; however, certain elections for tax consolidation are available for domestic groups, not applicable to a single foreign LLC).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory threshold; mandatory registration for any taxable activity (0 KRW threshold).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic tax invoices (e-Tax Invoice) issued via HomeTax System for all B2B transactions; real-time transmission to NTS; anti-fraud measures include digital signature and validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods exported from Korea, provided the exporter retains evidence of export, including customs clearance declaration and proof of payment in foreign currency. Services directly related to exported goods may also qualify if they are connected to the export transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Foreign Exchange Settlement Confirmation (or Inward Remittance Certificate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties include additional tax of up to 40% of the VAT amount, plus interest; criminal penalties for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rating benefits and potential suspension of export privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (The Central Bank of the Republic of Korea) and the Ministry of Economy and Finance as the foreign exchange oversight authority under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea maintains a highly liberalized but cautiously supervised convertible currency regime. The Korean won is freely convertible for current account transactions, including trade-related settlements, dividends, royalties, and service payments, subject to declaration through a licensed bank. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment, capital loans, and portfolio investment, require prior or simultaneous reporting under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, but are not generally subject to per-transaction approval unless classified as requiring enhanced regulation or exceeding prescribed thresholds. For a South Korean entity owned by non-residents, foreign exchange receipts can be retained in a domestic foreign currency demand deposit account indefinitely or converted into Korean won through an authorized foreign exchange bank. Profit remittances of dividends and liquidation proceeds are lawful after presenting tax clearance, audited financial statements, and the underlying foreign investment documentation. The central operational hurdle is proving the legitimate origin of the inbound FDI and substantiating the payout base, because banks will conduct enhanced due diligence on any dividend or loan repayment that appears inconsistent with revenue, equity, or documented trade volume.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: South Korea applies no fixed mandatory foreign currency surrender ratio. Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Regulations, export proceeds for goods must be collected within one year from the date of the export declaration unless an extension is approved by the head of the responsible foreign exchange bank, and the full amount must be received into a domestic foreign-currency or won-denominated account. Receipt may be kept in foreign currency or converted to Korean won. Any collection method not recognized by the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, or any retention abroad after the permitted term without approval, constitutes a violation and may result in administrative fines and foreign exchange transaction restrictions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Foreign digital banks and EMI-type platforms such as Revolut, Wise, or Airwallex are not licensed banks in South Korea and are legally barred from opening corporate demand deposit accounts, issuing KRW account numbers, or acting as the primary account servicer for a Korean resident limited company. The Financial Services Commission and the Bank of Korea permit only licensed financial companies, including internet-only banks such as KakaoBank, K Bank, and Toss Bank, to accept deposits and provide foreign exchange services. Foreign EMIs can only support cross-border payment initiation as technical gateways if the underlying transaction is cleared through a licensed domestic bank or a registered money transmitter, and even then the Korean entity must maintain its main operational and capital accounts at a Tier-1 Korean bank. Therefore, the viability of an offshore EMI as the company principal treasury rail is Low; it should be used only as an ancillary collection viewer and never for capital escrow, statutory dividend remittance, or trade settlement with a Korean tax or customs reporting requirement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: South Korean banking KYC rules, including the Real Name Financial Transactions Act and FATF-aligned suspicious transaction regulations, require for a newly formed Yuhan Hoesa that at least one statutory director or an expressly designated agent with signatory power and irrevocable power of attorney appear at the bank branch in person for identity verification and signature specimen. Remote consular proxy opening is possible only as a secondary authentication step after the agent identity has been apostilled or consularized and the bank has performed a live video interview; however, most Tier-1 commercial banks will still request physical attendance by a foreign or Korean director for the initial account activation. All signatories, including remote directors who will later use e-banking, must be individually AML screened before account issuance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Presence of a non-resident corporate shareholder with an opaque legal structure or low-tax jurisdiction domicile, creating an unidentified ultimate beneficial owner (UBO).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation and articles of association for every corporate shareholder; a UBO declaration disclosing all natural persons holding 10% or more and their chain of control; passport copies and proof of residential address of all UBOs; notarized declaration that no nominee shareholders exist; and, if applicable, authenticated consolidated ownership chart and tax transparency documentation from the jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the declared low-value plush-toy OEM manufacturing scope and projected cross-border transaction volumes or payment patterns that are unusually high relative to warehouse capacity and payroll.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed OEM manufacturing agreements with local and export customers; purchase orders and proforma invoices matching the declared scope; shipping documents including bills of lading or air waybills, packing lists, customs declarations, and export declarations; warehouse lease agreement; payroll and utilities records; and quarterly inventory valuation schedule showing production logic.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital injection from overseas shareholders without a commensurate equity issuance or FDI notification, possibly indicating unlicensed money lending or shell-funding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Korean foreign investment report notification receipt or certificate issued by a foreign exchange bank; board resolution approving share issuance; share subscription agreement; paid-in capital ledger entry; source-of-funds bank statements from the shareholder; shareholder tax returns or audited financials; and a sworn explanation of the full funding path.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, adverse media, or PEP indicators detected during initial screening on any director, shareholder, or end-buyer in the plush-toy supply chain, triggering enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full list of the ultimate beneficiaries of all export contracts; individual passport biographic pages and visas; valid residence permits; sanctions and PEP screening reports from independent databases; absence of links to restricted jurisdictions; end-buyer certificate of final use; and corporate register extracts of foreign buyers substantiating legitimate trading status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI proceeds for the Yuhan Hoesa must first be notified to an authorized foreign exchange bank under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act before the remittance wiring is executed. The foreign investor must submit a foreign investment report signed by the representative, together with a certified copy of the company business registration certificate, articles of incorporation, and a board resolution approving the investment. Funds are remitted via SWIFT MT103 with the investor name and the FDI capital injection purpose code in the remittance information field, and the receiving Korean bank will post them to a foreign currency deposit account or a won-denominated demand deposit account. The bank issues a foreign currency receipt certificate, which combined with the foreign investment report number is the primary capital verification evidence for the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the tax authorities. Companies failing to file the report before payment risk administrative fines and delayed repatriation of dividends; therefore the bank should receive the notification receipt number before the wire is released.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound trade disbursements, corporates should use SWIFT MT103 for direct telegraphic transfers, commercial letters of credit issued under UCP 600 for higher-value settlements, and documentary collections under URC 522. Korean banks clear Korean won payments via BOK-Wire+ and foreign-currency payments via the correspondent SWIFT network. The clearing rail must be supported by a trade contract, invoice, and customs records where required; the bank will apply the appropriate foreign exchange purpose code and may require presentation of goods inspection documents, bills of lading, or customs declarations before releasing funds for advance payments, raw material imports, or overseas commission payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore plain-vanilla forward foreign exchange contracts for exports and imports with a documented underlying real demand such as trade receivables or payables
FX swaps for temporary squaring of foreign-currency liquidity associated with underlying trade flows
FX options purchased for hedging trade receivables and payables, with no net speculative option selling
Cross-currency swaps between Korean won and USD, EUR, or JPY for trade-related cash flow hedging, provided the term and notional match the underlying commercial exposure

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only available to non-resident counterparties outside Korea; residents must use onshore deliverable forwards unless the relevant foreign exchange bank obtains Bank of Korea approval for a specific NDF hedge

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Corporation (Art. 159 of the Korean Commercial Act) and Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registry of Corporations, Local Court (the registration office having jurisdiction over the company's registered office); National Tax Service for tax filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the end of the fiscal year (for a December 31 fiscal year, by the last day of February); the general shareholders' meeting must be held within this period; foreign-invested companies may apply the foreign parent's fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalty for failure to file the annual report is governed by the Commercial Act; delay may trigger fines up to KRW 10 million and the court may compel filing; failure to file audited financial statements under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies may result in administrative fines and suspension or restriction on the auditor; persistence of non-compliance can lead to registration cancellation and administrative strike-off after repeated unfulfilled orders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return on business income and local income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) and relevant local government
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing deadline: March 31 of the year following the fiscal year for a calendar-year taxpayer (or within 3 months from the end of the fiscal year); extended deadline: generally up to 1 additional month upon application; for a December 31 fiscal year, final extended deadline is April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file: 20% penalty on unpaid tax; under-reporting penalty: 10% on the unpaid tax; failure to pay: 0.022% per day of the unpaid amount; delinquent tax collection proceedings and seizure of assets; continued non-compliance can lead to seizure and enforced collection, and if accompanied by continuous failure to maintain registration, administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Value-Added Tax return (first half and second half or preliminary returns)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year matching the calendar year: (1) January 1 – June 30 period: pre-filing due by June 30, final filing due by July 25; (2) July 1 – December 31 period: pre-filing due by December 31, final filing due by January 25 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file/underpayment: 10% of the unpaid VAT on unfiled/under-declared amount and 0.022% per day on unpaid amount; administrative seizure; chronic non-filing may lead to business registration cancellation and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Withholding income tax and social insurance filings and payments
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS); National Pension Service, National Health Insurance Service, Korea Employment & Labor Law compliance bodies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly withholding return and payment due by the 10th of the following month (or semi-annual return for eligible SMEs by the 10th of the following month after each half-year); social insurance contributions due by the 10th of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional tax of 0.022% per day on unpaid withheld amounts; criminal liability in case of intentional non-collection/non-payment; persistent violations may lead to enforcement measures and corporate registration strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual payroll and employment status report (foreign workers and clawback compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Employment and Labor and local immigration authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 31 for foreign employee status reports or within 14 days of change events; annual report due within 3 months of fiscal year-end for workplaces with 5 or more employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines per non-compliant employee; labor inspection referral; continued non-compliance may trigger business closure orders and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Business Report (for foreign investors holding shares or obtaining beneficial ownership) and Foreign Exchange Reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) via the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) / government-designated foreign exchange bank
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual report of foreign investment business: by the last day of February each year (for foreign-invested companies); additionally, changes in foreign investment status must be reported within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to KRW 10 million; provisions of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act; failure of the foreign investor to report may affect dividend remittances and reduce treaty benefits; repeated non-compliance may lead to revocation of foreign-invested company status and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Franchise/Information Disclosure Registration (if any licensing or franchise model used) and trade license renewal (business registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) or local tax office for business registration renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Business registration certificate: no annual renewal is normally required unless there are changes; change of details must be reported within 15 days; franchise registration, if applicable, must be renewed before the 30th day prior to the start of the business or upon material change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal or inaccurate registration: administrative fine under relevant acts; late change reporting: penalties; failure to maintain business registration can lead to tax collection difficulties and administrative strike-off of the entity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent certified CPA audit is mandatory for a Yuhan Hoesa under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies if (1) the company is a stock company (Yuhan Hoesa) and holds assets of at least KRW 12 billion; or (2) the company is a 'large company' as defined under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies where total assets exceed KRW 50 billion; or (3) under the Korean Commercial Act, a company with capital of at least KRW 1 billion and total assets of at least KRW 7 billion, having more than 100 employees (headcount), or whose paid-in capital is at least KRW 500 million and with outstanding debt of at least KRW 10 billion; or (4) the company voluntarily elects to adopt external audit; additionally, a company meeting the criteria of a 'company subject to external audit' under Article 2 of the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies is required to file audited financial statements with the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) through the Data Analysis, Retrieval and Transfer System (DART) within 90 days after fiscal year-end. For Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) considered 'small corporations' not exceeding the thresholds, audits may be waived, but the company must still prepare financial statements under the Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS) or Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (K-GAAP).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korea International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS) as adopted by the Korean Accounting Standards Board (KASB); Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (K-GAAP, also known as the Accounting Standards for Non-listed Entities and SME Standards) for non-listed SMEs, with the option to apply K-IFRS voluntarily; financial statements must be prepared in compliance with the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies and the Korean Commercial Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no separate annual UBO confirmation requirement under the Korean Commercial Act; however, every Yuhan Hoesa must maintain an accurate Register of Members and, upon any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership, file a change report with the Registry of Corporations at the local court within 30 days from the date of the share transfer or from the date of the resolution approving the transfer (or within the same 30-day window after the event under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act for foreign investors, and a foreign exchange report to the designated foreign exchange bank for foreigner share acquisitions). The company must also maintain a register of ultimate beneficial owners when applicable under financial transaction reporting obligations to the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU), but in all cases an annual confirmation of ownership is required for foreign-invested companies through the annual foreign investment business report to MOTIE/KOTRA due by February 28/29 of the following year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Auditors or statutory auditor records
Register of Charges/Mortgages (including pledges over shares and property securities)
Minute Book (records of general shareholders' meetings and board of directors' meetings)
Financial statements and supporting accounting books (journal, general ledger, and material vouchers)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - USD 2,500 per year, depending on the registered agent, local counsel, and compliance administration service provider in Seoul or regional jurisdiction
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 15,000 for a statutory external audit for a mid-sized Yuhan Hoesa applying K-GAAP/SME standards; lower-end for micro entities and higher-end for entities requiring K-IFRS, group audits, or complex intercompany transactions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: National headline: 9% on taxable income up to KRW 200,000,000; 19% on the next KRW 20,000,000,000; 21% on the next KRW 300,000,000,000; 24% above KRW 300,000,000,000. A 10% local income surtax is imposed on the national corporate tax, producing an aggregate top effective rate of 26.4%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Under the Tax Incentive Limitation Act: foreign-invested enterprises in Free Economic Zones may receive a 50-100% corporate tax exemption for the first 5 years; R&D credits up to 25% for SMEs and 30-50% for eligible new growth technologies; venture company and innovative manufacturing tax credits; facility investment and temporary investment tax credits for automation and ultrasonic seaming equipment; no patent box regime exists, but IP-related R&D expenditures are creditable against corporate income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Primary form: National Tax Service (NTS) HomeTax Form 11, the Domestic Corporation Corporate Income Tax Return, with the attached Corporate Income Tax Calculation Statement, Related Party International Transaction Schedule, and local corporate income tax return on the local government portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the prior year's tax is also pre-paid semi-annually using Form 11 schedules on June 30 and December 31.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment must be completed within 3 months after the fiscal-year end; for a December 31 fiscal year-end, the statutory due date is March 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate identity: legal name, Yuhan Hoesa registration number, tax office, representative director, and fiscal year period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any director is a non-resident, attach a valid power of attorney and appoint a domestic tax representative; failure to maintain a tax representative can result in a non-filing penalty, impractical electronic filing, and enhanced scrutiny of treaty relief claims.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales and revenue: report the full invoice value of custom plush mascot and stuffed animal OEM sales, including computerized embroidery, ultrasonic seaming, and co-packing services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue when the OEM contract is substantially performed and title passes. Foreign-currency export revenue must be converted into KRW using the spot rate on the transaction date or a prescribed averaging method. Sales to foreign related parties must be at arm's length and reconciled with TP Local File documentation; do not net out freight, insurance, or platform commissions from gross receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and operating expenses: fabric, polyester filling, embroidery threads, ultrasonic machine depreciation, labor, factory overhead, rental, and distribution expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments for offshore management fees, marketing fees, or IP royalties to non-resident related parties must be recognized only if economically real, substantively rendered, and supported by tax invoices; otherwise NTS may disallow the expense and assess withholding tax on deemed Korean-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss carryforward: reconcile financial statement profit to tax-basis income by adding non-deductible entertainment, provisions, and excess contributions and by deducting statutory reserves.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Depreciation differences on embroidery machines and tooling must be adjusted; expenses paid to a related foreign company lacking economic substance or CIGA may be treated as disguised dividend distributions and subject to non-resident dividend withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward deduction: apply unused prior-year net operating losses up to the statutory carryforward period and compute the remaining taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean LLC is taxed at entity level; losses may not be flowed through to foreign shareholders. Maintain a complete NOL schedule; where an ownership change has occurred, NTS anti-circumvention rules may limit loss utilization if the dormant business reopens.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate tax computation: apply the progressive national rates, add 10% local income surtax, subtract foreign tax credits, R&D credits, withholding tax credits, and prior prepayments; state final refund or balance payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach Schedule 6 disclosures of non-resident shareholders and declare any dividends resolved after the balance-sheet date for Korean withholding purposes. Reduced treaty rates must be evidenced by valid Tax Residency Certificates before this return is filed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late non-filing triggers a 20% penalty on unpaid tax under the Framework Act on National Taxes; under-reported tax carries a 10% negligence penalty, while fraudulent under-reporting or over-reporting carries a 40% penalty. Late payment adds 0.025% per day. Willful tax evasion is referred under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act, carrying imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to 5 times the evaded tax; directors may be Blacklisted/departure-banned by NTS during the investigation.
